in the near field of an electromagnetic source, the velocity of the main body of an electromagnetic wave is locally negative, i.e., the waveform travels in the opposite direction to the wave front.

the near-field of an electromagnetic field propagating in free space does not propagate in the same direction as the wave front, and that the near-field dynamics are more complex than simple propagation.

the dynamics of the vector potential and its relation to the electromagnetic field.
the question of whether the electromagnetic field can be described in terms of a single wave front travelling in free space at a constant velocity.
